fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area civic and economic conditions, including claims of widespread financial strain, hotel rate competition and receiverships, apartment rents and leasing practices, and a proposed election safeguard involving numbered ballots. Coverage also discusses a Dade County Medical Society call for nurses and debate over 20-hour duty, a city egg-labeling ordinance, disputes involving privately owned electric power service in the Redlands/Homestead area and Florida Power & Light Company, Miami Beach bulkheading costs, and a report on an inquest concerning Jessie Peterson under Justice of the Peace H. W. Griffin. Regular features, letters to the editor, and entertainment/sports notices appear.
